notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Shocking Sharpshooter, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Shocking Sharpshooter triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
